title: Vulkan Performance +
description: A Performance Modpack based around the Vulkan Mod, with some QOL mods aswell. This Modpack uses the Fabric Modloader.
body:
ModPack mainly aimed towards performance, using Vulkan Mod, to give better Chunk times, and FPS. This uses Fabric as a base to load the Mods.

**Notes:**

- If there are any issues, please make a ticket in our [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/39vfvtBvAz).

**Mods Used:**

- Bad Oprimizations
- Better Ping Display
- Better F3  
- Borderless Windowed Vulkan
- Chat Animation
- C2ME (Concurrent Chunk Management Engine)
- Continuity
- Dark Loading Screen
- Debugify
- Durablilty Tooltip
- E4MC
- Entity Culling
- Fast IP Ping
- Fast Noise
- Ferrite Core
- Immediately Fast
- Lithium
- Mod Menu
- Model Gap Fix
- More Chat History
- Not Enough Animations
- Packet Fixer
- Thread Tweak
- Vulkan Mod
- Zoomify

Logo made with the help of **Canva**.

**Licensing Note:** This modpack is an independent project and is NOT officially associated with or endorsed by the original developers of Vulkan Mod, or any other included mod. All mods included in this ModPack are open-source and used under their respective licenses (mostly MIT or GPL).
